Simulated dispersal tracks with behavioural states

Source: R/data.R
sim_states.Rd

sim_tracks split at monitoring gaps longer than one day with divide.track.by.gap, regularised to hourly locations with resample.ctmm, and classified by segment with a hidden Markov model using fitHMM.wrap with stationary = TRUE (the stationary state, mostly daytime rest, is merged into the encamped state).

Usage

sim_states

Format

A data.frame with 10 columns:

ID

Individual identifier.

id_split

Track segment identifier (individual and segment number).

time

Location time (POSIXct, UTC).

time_s

Location time in seconds since 1970-01-01.

x, y

Easting and northing (m, EPSG:25830).

step

Step length (m).

angle

Turning angle (radians).

state

Viterbi-decoded state (1 = Transit, 2 = Encamped).

sex

Static individual attribute.

Source

Simulated; see data-raw/simulate_tracks.R in the package sources.
